snippet.title: Time To Wake Up - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019341/

Time To Wake Up is a first-person psychological horror game, where you find yourself stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings in hopes of escaping this dream slowly turning into a nightmare. Out now on PS5!

#ps5 #ps5games #timetowakeup
